dct_description_sm: Relief shown pictorially.; Navigational chart.; Oriented with north to the right.; Includes towns, fortifications, woods, and mountain ranges.; Includes decorative cartouche with sea monsters.; Includes illustrations of ships in battle, sea monsters, and two people in Europeanized versions of indigenous clothing.; Inset map is framed by an illustration of a ship with armor, weapons, and instruments.; Inset: Bachian I. Scale approximately 1:100,000.; Dutch text on verso: Moluccen.; After the Sultan of Ternate granted the spice concession to the Dutch in 1607, they established a settlement on Bacan in 1609 and rapidly gained control of the Moluccas.
37 x 48 centimeters on sheet 54 x 62 centimeters
